notes.title: Upcoming Localizations
notes.content:
I just want to inform you all that translations for 'Parking Cop Simulator' are being planned, and will soon be underway. 

The game is planned to be available in these languages in addition to English:

- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Spanish
- German
- French
- Brazilian Portuguese
- Japanese
- Korean

However, it will most likely take several months before the first translations will be available. This is due to the way the game engine is designed which does not allow for fast replacement of text. Therefore, each translation will take around 75-100 hours for me to transfer to the game due to the immense amount of eventing that will need to be changed for every single vehicle. 

Even if the translations will be long underway, I hope you will still stick around. :)

- Shoho Games
